text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen, successfully<n>held thanks to
the hard work of so<n>many people, kicks off without
a<n>hitch.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower proclaims that she will<n>give this race
everything she has<n>before heading to the gates.
